_readme: Source videos from James's '2026 Website Refresh' Google Drive folder (shared by link). scripts/media.mjs downloads each, transcodes to web H.264 + poster, and writes /media/<id>.mp4. 'loop' also makes a short muted background clip for hero and tiles.

items._note: Owner-selected (James, Sep 24) for the Home quick tile For your listings: Westhampton luxury home virtual twilight. Build encodes 2000/900 px WebP from the original; static/v/ holds Codex 1600 px fallback.

Owner-selected (James, Sep 24) for the Home quick tile For your brand: Noah Knows Podcast Episode 10 action shot 19 (29 MB original). Location not verified; never label it as the studio. static/v/ holds Codex 1600 px fallback.

items._note: James, Sep 25 2026: Creator Studios horizontal opener. ~327 MB 4K original stays in Drive; the build makes a 720p film, a 1080p muted hero loop and a WebP poster.

James, Sep 28 2026 page review: Island Federal podcast short (vertical 1080x1920, HEVC, 33.4 s, 32,961,936 bytes, SHA-256 f9716a2cfd7527166e91ac6824255e06a908018b72d799b001a78a3eef39b039), staged unchanged by Codex. Muted 25 s excerpt from 3 s (540x960, libx264 CRF 28) and a WebP poster at 6 s, encoded on the Cowork VM. The clip has word-by-word captions burned in; it plays muted only, so no caption track is offered.

James, Sep 28 2026 page review: Agent Content hero: the committed on-camera expertise clip (vertical 720x1280), 25 s muted excerpt from 3 s, centred over a blurred fill of itself in a 1280x720 frame. Muted and decorative; the playable clip with its burned-in captions stays in the examples.

James, Sep 28 2026 page review: Creator Studios Space section: the approved 36 s horizontal demo reel with the audio track removed (video stream copied, no re-encode), so the in-section player autoplays muted and has no soundtrack to unmute. Poster is the reel poster.

James, Sep 28 2026: silent visual use of the 33 s RevivaLuxe brand film approved for Commercial. Exact source: the previously published commercial-revivaluxe.mp4 (git blob f5736cec5970aabfe7a86858264252cea2466698, 5,149,376 bytes, SHA-256 b56a8e09fce6c99ace2c586deecc061a3e516d0fded2426ddce188ab80b2be60; vertical 720x1280 h264, 33.43 s, with an AAC music track and a data stream). The unlicensed soundtrack is physically removed: video stream only (-map 0:v:0 -an -dn -sn, metadata stripped), re-encoded 540x960 libx264 CRF 28 faststart; ffprobe reports one stream. WebP poster at 8 s (treatment). The audio-bearing film and the separate 75 s tour stay withheld.

James, Sep 28 2026: Jack Richardson video testimonial for About, added by James to the brief folder (3840x2160 h264 30 fps + AAC stereo, 46.93 s, 470,157,272 B, SHA-256 b5dc445dd8ae5053fab3f22e968fb7954ec0248bf2f5abfb3105e263ae62f11b). James confirmed the background music is licensed for the website and the credit is Jack Richardson. Encoded on the Cowork VM: 1280x720 libx264 CRF 23 (maxrate 3000k) + AAC 128k, metadata stripped, faststart; WebP poster at 4 s. Captions are burned in; no separate CC track yet.
